info.title: Undercore Orchestrator — backend API
info.description: New integrations: v2 plus process health and node overview. Legacy v1 client operations are documented separately in docs/public/api.md. Trusted backend only; it authorizes users and slots. Bodies are limited to 8192 bytes. Runtime validation includes identity, expiry and state checks beyond JSON Schema. HTTPS is required off loopback. This artifact never enables live Swagger.
